comments.text: Something like this happened with a former student of mine. If anyone had asked which kids might be a danger to others or themselves, this kid wouldn't have even been on the radar. comments.text: I worked at a state university many years ago, & a young man followed an employee into our office & tried to follow him into the bathroom. It was winter, & the student had no shoes or socks on. He started talking nonsense, mostly numbers. The staff froze & didn't know what to do. I grew up with mentally ill family members, so I started walking to my office to call the police. PTL, when asked by the young man where I was going, I told him my name & that I had to make an important business call & be right back, an answer which he accepted. I did go back & tried to keep him occupied with the other staff until the police came. University can be a real strain on young people, so if you see troubling behavior from a classmate, please tell someone & get help.
